remarks: Experience 1515 Summer St, Apt 506 at The Metropolitan, a recently renovated residence in the heart of downtown Stamford. This light-filled unit features 9+ foot ceilings, an open layout, and updated finishes throughout. The brand-new kitchen includes a waterfall-style countertop, modern cabinetry, updated lighting, Wolf cooktop, and a Sub-Zero refrigerator. Recent improvements continue throughout the home with new hardwood flooring, modern chandeliers and light fixtures. The fully renovated bathroom with porcelain tile flooring features marble and mother of pearl detailing, Kohler fixtures, and Visual Comfort lighting. The spacious walk-in closet offers generous storage adjacent to the primary bedroom. Additional upgrades include a newer HVAC system and an in-unit washer and dryer. Residents of The Metropolitan enjoy access to a fitness center, an assigned wine cellar, and a resident lounge located on the first floor, all within close proximity to downtown dining, retail, entertainment, and transportation options.
